"""strike: one attack pulse a call, and a record of what each call was given (an instrument)."""
import hashlib, json, sys
LOOP = True
s = json.load(sys.stdin)
data = open(s["frame"], "rb").read()
with open("mine/strike_calls.jsonl", "a") as f:
    f.write(json.dumps({"step": s["step"], "call": s["call"], "ticks": s["ticks"],
                        "budget": s["budget"], "health": s["health"],
                        "sha": hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()[:12], "bytes": len(data)}) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"actions": [{"action": {"attack": 1}, "repeat": 2}, {"action": {}, "repeat": 11}],
                  "again": True, "memo": {"n": s["memo"].get("n", 0) + 1},
                  "note": "pulse %d" % s["call"] if s["call"] % 8 == 0 else ""}))
